structurePatterns.container: background: white, borderRadius: 16px, padding: 20px, boxShadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), border: 2px solid transparent, transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), cursor: pointer, position: relative, overflow: hidden
structurePatterns.topBar: position: absolute, top: 0, left: 0, right: 0, height: 4px, background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gradient-start), var(--gradient-end))
structurePatterns.header: display: flex, alignItems: center, gap: 16px, marginBottom: 16px
structurePatterns.roleBadge: display: inline-flex, alignItems: center, gap: 6px, padding: 4px 10px, background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gradient-start), var(--gradient-end)), borderRadius: 20px, fontSize: 12px, color: white
structurePatterns.statusIndicator: display: flex, alignItems: center, gap: 8px, padding: 6px 12px, background: #f9fafb, borderRadius: 20px
structurePatterns.statusDot: width: 10px, height: 10px, borderRadius: 50%, animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite
structurePatterns.metrics: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr), gap: 12px, marginBottom: 16px
structurePatterns.metric: display: flex, flexDirection: column, alignItems: center, gap: 8px, padding: 12px, background: #f9fafb, borderRadius: 12px
